title: Pairwise vote profile
statement: Given a profile of $n$ voters' strict rankings of candidates $a,b,c$ and one of the three cyclic contests $a$ against $b$, $b$ against $c$, or $c$ against $a$, the pairwise vote profile assigns each voter the sign $+1$ if that voter prefers the first named candidate and $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: a contest among the three cyclic pairwise contests
